source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 552 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 552 was established by Ordinance No. 23922, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 23, 1999. Ordinance No. 23922 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 552 is established on property generally located on the southwest line of South Lamar Street southeast of the southwestward prolongation of the southeast line of Starks Avenue. The size of PD 552 is approximately 22.115 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Development/Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.104. DEVELOPMENT/LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 552A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development/ landscape plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in Subsection (b), the uses permitted in this district are all uses allowed in an IM Industrial Manufacturing District.

(b) Outside salvage and reclamation. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

Except as noted below, yard, lot, and space regulations must comply with the provisions for the IM Industrial Manufacturing District:

(1) Front, side, and rear yard. For an outside salvage and reclamation use, all front, side, and rear yards are as shown on the development/ landscape plan.

(2) Height. Maximum structure height for an outside salvage and reclamation use is 36 feet.

(3) Stack height. The stacking height of objects is limited to a maximum of eight feet when within 40 feet of the solid screening fence. Beyond 40 feet, additional stack height is permitted if the additional height is one foot higher for each five feet of setback from the 40 foot point. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

For an outside salvage and reclamation use, off-street parking and loading must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. For all other uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking/loading requirements for each use. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.110. LANDSCAPING.

For IM Industrial Manufacturing District uses, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X. For an outside salvage and reclamation use, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.112. INGRESS AND EGRESS.

Ingress and egress for an outside salvage and reclamation use must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.113. SCREENING.

A nine-foot solid screening fence must be erected along:

(1) Lamar Street,

(2) the northwestern property line,

(3) the southeastern property line beginning at Lamar Street and extending for a distance of 200 feet, and

(4) the southwestern property line if, at any time, the adjacent rail bed is either reduced in height or used for any purpose other than rail traffic. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.114. MAINTENANCE.

The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) For an outside salvage and reclamation use, the dismantling of automobiles and other salvage and reclamation must be conducted within an enclosed structure when within 500 feet of a residential zoning district.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-552.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 552 is located on Zoning Map No. L-8. (Ord. Nos. 23922; 25163)
